result:
I’d make a fair start in life independent of where someone is born—so every child could grow up safe, nourished, healthy, and able to get a good education.

It wouldn’t solve everything, but its effects would compound across generations: fewer people trapped by circumstances, more freedom to choose a life, and far less human potential lost simply through bad luck.

I’d make a fair start in life independent of where someone is born—so every child could grow up safe, nourished, healthy, and able to get a good education.

It wouldn’t solve everything, but its effects would compound across generations: fewer people trapped by circumstances, more freedom to choose a life, and far less human potential lost simply through bad luck.
